title: Salidroside targets the Notch1/Hes5 axis to reconstruct the molecular innate immune-vascular network and correlates with repair after ischemic stroke.
authors: Zeng, Jing; Huang, Xiaohua; Zeng, Jingyi; Huang, Qi; Song, Wenyi; Xie, Youfeng; Liang, Guining; Wei, Qingyan; Lan, Yating; Zou, Donghua; Li, Rongjie; Gu, Lian
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞测序和分子对接研究红景天苷对缺血性脑卒中后Notch1/Hes5轴及免疫-血管网络的调控，虽涉及分子对接但核心为细胞图谱与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ischemic stroke (IS) induces profound dysregulation of the neuro-molecular innate immune-vascular network, yet the molecular immune states and regulatory mechanisms of key cellular subpopulations remain insufficiently defined. Although traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) exhibits multi-target immunomodulatory potential, its cell-type and cell-state-specific actions within the ischemic brain microenvironment at single-cell resolution remain unclear. METHODS: Single-cell RNA sequencing was used to construct a cellular atlas of the ischemic mouse brain, followed by integrative bioinformatic analyses to characterize innate immune-related neural cell subpopulations and their regulatory networks. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were applied to identify salidroside (SAL), a major active compound of Rhodiola, and predict its potential molecular targets. In vivo experiments were performed to validate cellular and molecular changes associated with SAL treatment. RESULTS: In a mouse model of IS, ischemic injury induced pronounced imbalances across multiple immune and glial cell subpopulations. A transcriptionally defined Notch1(+) Hes5(+) astrocyte (ASC), enriched for progenitor-like and reparative gene signatures, was markedly reduced after ischemic injury, whereas reactive SerpinA3N(+) ASC and pro-inflammatory Sell(+) microglia (MG) were expanded. Additionally, alterations were observed in immune-regulatory cell populations, including Cxcl12(+) endothelial cells (ECs) and Gpr34(+) Ptgs1(+) MG. In vivo validation showed that SAL treatment was associated with modulation of Notch1/Hes5 signaling in ASC, reduced reactive ASC features, and partial normalization of ECs alterations, accompanied by changes consistent with attenuated neuroimmune activation. These effects coincided with altered intercellular communication, particularly involving NOTCH signaling. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides single-cell-level insights into innate immune microenvironment remodeling following IS and identifies a Notch1(+) Hes5(+) ASC subpopulation with transcriptional features associated with reparative-related programs and responsiveness to SAL. The findings suggest that SAL-associated neuroprotection was accompanied by modulation of ASC states and immune-glial communication, highlighting the potential of SAL-associated immunoregulatory effects at the single-cell level in IS.
abstract_zh: 背景：缺血性卒中（IS）会引发神经-分子固有免疫-血管网络的显著失调，然而关键细胞亚群的分子免疫状态及其调控机制仍未被充分定义。尽管中药（TCM）展现出多靶点免疫调节潜力，但其在缺血性脑微环境中、单细胞分辨率下的细胞类型和细胞状态特异性作用仍不清楚。方法：利用单细胞RNA测序构建缺血小鼠脑的细胞图谱，随后进行整合生物信息学分析，以表征固有免疫相关神经细胞亚群及其调控网络。应用网络药理学和分子对接技术，鉴定红景天主要活性化合物红景天苷（SAL），并预测其潜在分子靶点。开展体内实验以验证与SAL治疗相关的细胞和分子变化。结果：在IS小鼠模型中，缺血性损伤诱导了多种免疫和胶质细胞亚群的显著失衡。一个转录水平定义的Notch1(+) Hes5(+) 星形胶质细胞（ASC）亚群，富集祖细胞样和修复性基因特征，在缺血性损伤后显著减少，而反应性SerpinA3N(+) ASC和促炎性Sell(+) 小胶质细胞（MG）则扩增。此外，还观察到免疫调节细胞群的改变，包括Cxcl12(+) 内皮细胞（EC）和Gpr34(+) Ptgs1(+) MG。体内验证显示，SAL治疗与ASC中Notch1/Hes5信号通路调节、反应性ASC特征减少以及EC改变的部分正常化相关，并伴随与神经免疫激活减弱一致的变化。这些效应与细胞间通讯改变同时发生，尤其涉及NOTCH信号通路。结论：本研究提供了IS后固有免疫微环境重塑的单细胞水平见解，并鉴定了一个Notch1(+) Hes5(+) ASC亚群，其转录特征与修复相关程序及对SAL的响应性相关。研究结果表明，SAL相关神经保护作用伴随ASC状态和免疫-胶质通讯的调节，凸显了SAL在IS中单细胞水平免疫调节效应的潜力。
